description: This file declares functions related to quantization and dequantization operations, as well as quantized arithmetic (add, sub, mul, div) and a 2D convolution for tensors in Vulkan backend for PyTorch.

methods.name: quantize_per_tensor
methods.description: Per-tensor quantization of a tensor with specified scale, zero_point, and data type.

methods.name: quantize_per_tensor_tensor_qparams
methods.description: Quantizes a tensor using tensor-based scale and zero_point parameters.

methods.name: dequantize_helper
methods.description: Helper function to dequantize a tensor with specified scale, zero_point, and data type.

methods.name: quantized_add
methods.description: Performs quantized addition of two tensors with specified scale and zero_point.

methods.name: quantized_sub
methods.description: Performs quantized subtraction of two tensors with specified scale and zero_point.

methods.name: quantized_mul
methods.description: Performs quantized multiplication of two tensors with specified scale and zero_point.

methods.name: quantized_div
methods.description: Performs quantized division of two tensors with specified scale and zero_point.

methods.name: quantized_conv2d
methods.description: Performs a 2D convolution on quantized tensors with specified parameters.

methods.name: quantized_upsample_nearest2d
methods.description: Performs nearest neighbor upsampling on a quantized tensor with scale factors or output sizes.
